summary: bug-1 is fixed. saveIdea() now sets an ideaSaving flag around ideaSaveNow() and releases it in a finally block. New regression suite tests/03-for-index-html-page-in-idee/double-save.js slows ideaAppendTo() by 600 ms and then checks: a double Ctrl+Enter, three Ctrl+Enter presses spaced inside the window, and a double-click on the Save button each append the idea exactly once and call ideaAppendTo once. The guard is released afterwards in every case: after a success, after a failed write (null result), after a thrown write, and after empty-idea attempts, and a later idea still saves. All 13 checks pass. The existing picker suite (tests/03-for-index-html-page-in-idee/picker.js, 81 checks, including double Ctrl+Enter) passes fully. tests/idea.js has one failure, 'idea button is right of New', which is known issue #3 in CLAUDE.md and is out of scope. I did not run tests/verify.js. Decision: Bash was refused for compound and env-prefixed commands in this session, so each test was run as a plain node command with the default browser resolution, which worked.
